unknown and tampered results are 404. The file name carries no reference, token or name.

AdvisorAssessmentSummary.title: AdvisorAssessmentSummary
AdvisorAssessmentSummary.description: Shown to administrators on a lead that was submitted from an assessment.

AdvisorContext.title: AdvisorContext
AdvisorContext.description: V2: richer business and integration context, enumerated only (no free text, no personal data).

AdvisorRequest.title: AdvisorRequest
AdvisorRequest.description:
What a visitor submits. No personal data is requested.

`contract_version` "1" (the default) is the original contract, unchanged. "2" requires `context`
and returns V2 insights as well; V2-only fields are rejected on a V1 request instead of being
silently ignored.

AdvisorResponseV2.title: AdvisorResponseV2
AdvisorResponseV2.description: V2 response: the unchanged V1 fields plus the contract version and the insights.

AiManagedDetails.title: AiManagedDetails
AiManagedDetails.description:
Descriptive information about a client's AI system (AI Managed Services inquiries).

Never credentials, keys, customer records or documents: free text is checked for secrets.
Stored in `leads.service_details` (JSONB, `{"kind": "ai_managed", ...}`).

AiManagedQualificationOut.title: AiManagedQualificationOut
AiManagedQualificationOut.description: Admin-only triage of an AI Managed Services inquiry (app/services/ai_managed_qualification.py).

AssessmentScoreRequest.title: AssessmentScoreRequest
AssessmentScoreRequest.description: Answers only: option keys, booleans and numbers. Weights, points or scores are rejected.

Basis.title: Basis
Basis.description: Where an insight comes from: an input the visitor chose, the assessment, or a named rule.

delivery_status.title: Delivery Status
delivery_status.description: Highest status of the domain's families.

service_count.title: Service Count
service_count.description: Published services, assessments and workshops in this domain.

contact_service.title: Contact Service
contact_service.description: Lead category to pre-select in the contact form.

services.title: Services
services.description: Published services whose primary domain this is.

delivery_status.title: Delivery Status
delivery_status.description: Highest status of the domain's families.

service_count.title: Service Count
service_count.description: Published services, assessments and workshops in this domain.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Primary domain key of a service, or the domain's own code.

EntityUpdate.title: EntityUpdate
EntityUpdate.description: The editor's working copy. Lists are replaced as a whole (ordering = list order).

note.title: Note
note.default: Evaluated on request against stored records. Nothing is sent or notified.

FamilyEdit.title: FamilyEdit
FamilyEdit.description:
A service family of a domain. `key` is the part after "<domain>." and cannot be renamed:
a new key creates a new family; a family left out of the list is archived, not deleted.

note.title: Note
note.default: No live telemetry. Records are synthetic samples or manual imports; costs are estimates from the rate cards entered here.

Freshness.title: Freshness
Freshness.description: Always present: where the numbers come from and how old the newest record is.

ItemEdit.title: ItemEdit
ItemEdit.description: One list entry in both locales (the lists stay aligned between BG and EN).

LeadLocale.title: LeadLocale
LeadLocale.description: Language of the website the inquiry was sent from (and preferred communication language).

LeadUpdate.title: LeadUpdate
LeadUpdate.description:
Change pipeline status and/or service categorisation.

`expected_status` enables optimistic concurrency: if another administrator changed the
status in the meantime, the update is rejected with 409 instead of silently overwriting it.

free_lead_categories.title: Free Lead Categories
free_lead_categories.description: ServiceKey values not yet used by a catalogue service.

Parameters.title: Parameters
Parameters.description: Generation parameters. Only these keys exist; anything else (e.g. an API key) is rejected.

QuoteRequestCreate.title: QuoteRequestCreate
QuoteRequestCreate.description: Request for a written quote: the contact fields plus structured project information.

ReadinessDetailsOut.title: ReadinessDetailsOut
ReadinessDetailsOut.description: Stored AI readiness submission as shown to admins (levels and computed result only).

ReadinessMeta.title: ReadinessMeta
ReadinessMeta.description: What the browser needs to describe the save/report options honestly.

ReadinessReportRequest.title: ReadinessReportRequest
ReadinessReportRequest.description: Anonymous PDF report. `company` is printed on the cover only and never stored or logged.

ReadinessSubmissionCreate.title: ReadinessSubmissionCreate
ReadinessSubmissionCreate.description: Optional hand-off to the team: results plus contact details. Creates a lead.

ResultConsultationRequest.title: ResultConsultationRequest
ResultConsultationRequest.description: Optional: ask for a consultation about a saved result. Creates a lead; nothing is required to see results.

ResultReportRequest.title: ResultReportRequest
ResultReportRequest.description: `pdf` downloads the PDF; `json` returns the same document for the accessible HTML view.

RunIn.title: RunIn
RunIn.description: One execution record. Metadata and counters only — there is no field for prompt or output content.

token.title: Token
token.description: Returned once, when the result is saved. Store it: it cannot be recovered.

custom_page.title: Custom Page
custom_page.description: Rendered by a dedicated website route instead of the service template.

duration.description: Indicative duration band in working days (assessments, workshops).

custom_page.title: Custom Page
custom_page.description: Rendered by a dedicated website route instead of the service template.

duration.description: Indicative duration band in working days (assessments, workshops).

SolutionDetailsOut.title: SolutionDetailsOut
SolutionDetailsOut.description: The design of a solution-builder enquiry as the admin sees it (enumerated keys; labels client-side).

SolutionEnquiryCreate.title: SolutionEnquiryCreate
SolutionEnquiryCreate.description: Optional enquiry with a solution design attached. Creates a lead; the plan never needs it.

TeamDetailsOut.title: TeamDetailsOut
TeamDetailsOut.description: AI team configurator consultation as shown to admins (enumerated configuration and estimate).

TeamPlanOut.title: TeamPlanOut
TeamPlanOut.description: Everything derived on the server from the configuration (enumerated keys; texts are client-side).

TeamSubmissionCreate.title: TeamSubmissionCreate
TeamSubmissionCreate.description: Optional consultation request: configuration plus contact details. Creates a lead.

note.title: Note
note.default: No monitoring source is connected. This portal shows only records entered by the studio team.

note.title: Note
note.default: No telemetry source is connected. Execution records exist only as labelled synthetic samples or manual imports; nothing is collected from client systems.

TelemetryStatus.title: TelemetryStatus
TelemetryStatus.description: Always reported, so a client never mistakes an empty dashboard for a healthy system.

Tool.title: Tool
Tool.description: A declared tool: what the agent may call. A declaration only — no endpoint, code or credential.

TranslationEdit.title: TranslationEdit
TranslationEdit.description: Texts of one locale. Empty strings are stored as empty (allowed in drafts, not for publishing).
